title: Red, White, and Royal Blue
author: Casey McQuiston
current_text: Cecil County Public Schools listed Red, White, and Royal Blue for removal from its media center collections on October 12, 2022. The Rockingham County School Board voted to remove Red, White, and Royal Blue from school libraries after Superintendent Dr. Larry Shifflett said it contained sexually explicit content as defined in RCPS Policy IIABA.

sources.quote:
ROCKINGHAM COUNTY, VA (Rocktown Now) – The Rockingham County School Board has voted to remove six books from their schools’ libraries during tonight’s meeting.
Superintendent Dr. Larry Shifflett recommended to remove Red, White, and Royal Blue, Tilt, and Tricks. Dr. Shifflett said the reason for removal was because the books contain sexually explicit content as defined in RCPS Policy IIABA. The motion for the three books passed unanimously.
